For massage therapists and students who want better techniques, career advice, and smarter treatments.

Explore live, webinar, and on-demand CEU courses:
bodyworksdw.com/continuing-education/

Bodyworks DW is a NYC-based medical massage practice and CE provider founded by David Weintraub, LMT. On this channel, we share massage demos, anatomy breakdowns, clinical reasoning, pain-focused treatment ideas, body mechanics, and honest career guidance for massage therapists who want stronger skills, better results, and more longevity in the field.

Our teaching is shaped by real work with real clients inside a busy New York City practice, along with years of hands-on education for therapists and students.

We also share some content for clients and curious viewers who want to better understand massage therapy, myofascial release, and how thoughtful bodywork can help with pain and tension.
